global_optimum: NOT_PROVEN. The policy is the best measured member of the bounded local portfolio. Both BF16 and GPTQ routes are automatically derived from two strictly guarded runs per implementation plus veto-only historical baseline envelopes. Architecture-level decoding, quantized tied-embedding formats, broader prompts, sampling, sequence lengths, power-locked repeats, other GPUs, and future vLLM releases remain open dimensions. A prepacked sidecar removes online conversion time but does not change the steady-state route or eliminate the dense tied weight.
